construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this build using synthetic fixtures.

shared_schema.input: Version 1 object: synthetic=true; catalog {currency, products [{sku,name,price_minor,stock}]}; customer {customer_id,consent_personalization,preferred_sku}; basket {basket_id,items [{sku,quantity}]}; clickstream [{timestamp,customer_id,event,sku}]; knowledge_base [{id,topic,sku,days}]; request {question,sku,personalize}. All fields required; nullable SKU where applicable.
shared_schema.output: Version 1 synthetic object with status answered/abstained, nullable answer/reason, citations, nullable catalog product including currency, customer identity/personalized flag and unchanged basket. Error envelope: schema_version,status=error,error.
shared_schema.validation: One Validator class validates input and generated output. Closed field sets, exact booleans, nonnegative bounded integer prices/stock, positive quantities/days, reference integrity, unique SKU/article/scope, timezone-aware event timestamps, explicit consent and exact grounded answer templates.
shared_schema.money: Integer minor units in USD/EUR/GBP; formatted with exact integer arithmetic.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated shared request -> consent gate -> bounded question-topic retrieval -> SKU-specific policy lookup with global fallback or catalog lookup -> grounded template -> shared output validation.

behavior.retrieval: Full-question deterministic matching. Supported canonical topics: price, stock, returns, shipping; natural phrasings enumerated in PATTERNS. SKU is supplied separately. SKU policy takes precedence over general policy. Multiple clauses or unsupported topics explicitly abstain.
behavior.abstention: Consent required, unsupported question, missing product or missing knowledge produce status=abstained, no answer and no citations; CLI exits 0.
behavior.personalization: Explicit personalize=true requires asserted consent. Preferred synthetic SKU then latest timestamped clickstream SKU is used only with consent; explicit SKU wins. Basket context is echoed, not used implicitly for targeting.
behavior.retail_constraints: Prices and stock exactly match supplied catalog snapshot. Reviews and endorsements are never generated; free-text knowledge articles and arbitrary generated claims are not accepted. Consent is a demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented validation gate, not compliance certification.
behavior.errors: Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite JSON values, schema and file errors yield one JSON error object and exit 2.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: Fictitious Cloud Mug and Meadow Tote; invented SYN-prefixed SKUs, prices and inventory; synthetic shopper Alex, basket and clickstream. Tests exercise opted-in/out persona variants.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clock dependence, LLM step, external calls or persistent runtime state.

included: Structured catalog feed and clickstream log

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: example input printed one grounded JSON object with status answered and exited 0. Tests also verified JSON error envelopes and exit 2 for invalid input, missing files and incorrect arguments.
